text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticed Mihono Bourbon training silently 
in gym.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hoo... hoo... hoo... hoo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appears she has continued intense workout 
without rest for nearly two hours.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for vocal input. Was immersed in 
computational thought.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――One verification query. Do you 
experience fear toward me?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Previously, rumors circulated among 
students speculating I am cyborg.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprised by absurd claim, curious, 
decided to hear details.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Remaining neutral without confirming or 
denying, rumors accumulated exaggerated 
claims...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hear that?! Mihono Bourbon-san can fire 
eye beams!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! She shoots missiles from mouth 
too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rumors spawned further rumors, evolving 
into massive scale.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, simply returning dropped 
towel――

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Spare me!!! Anything but the beam!! 
Anything but the beaaam~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: External evaluations cause no concern.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, unintended infliction of fear is 
evaluated as issue requiring resolution.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Was searching for corrective protocols 
just now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If viable solution known, requesting 
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Overcoming lack of expression.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, evaluated with high probability as 
lacking facial variation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for valuable advice. Commencing 
facial muscle training immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she was seen silently working 
on facial muscle training—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Good work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
S-Such a cute smile... Is she really a 
cyborg...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Not scary at all...! She really is just 
normal horse girl...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Misunderstanding seemed successfully 
resolved.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Intonation... raising and lowering vocal 
pitch. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
High probability inorganic tone of voice 
was root cause of misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Situation assessed. Intonation inputted. 
Thank you for valuable advice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then Mihono Bourbon attempted her own 
intonation. However—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ev-er-y-o-o-o-n-e~~~ Go-o-o-d wo-o-o-r-k 
to-o-o-da-a-a-y~~~

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: ... Why is she chanting...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know... Did she get firmware 
update...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Resulted in scaring them again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
... Commencing search for alternate 
resolution method.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, preoccupied with thinking of 
another solution, she couldn't focus on 
training.
